next.reason: 1985 GR5: each re-OPEN 'must be preceded by the execution of a CLOSE statement, without the REEL, UNIT, or LOCK phrase'. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR2 'The file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall not be open' (status 41, §2023:9.1.13.7 GR1, as in 1985); only a CLOSE 'without the UNIT phrase' ends the open mode (§2023:14.9.6.4 GR8), and REEL equals UNIT (§2023:14.9.6.3 SR2). The LOCK exclusion is vacuous: the 2023 CLOSE format §2023:14.9.6.2 has no LOCK phrase (that removal belongs to the CLOSE format record). A conforming 1985 reopen sequence behaves the same.
